## Risk v1[](/Tiny-doc/tink_docs_api/api-risk/)

The Risk Decisioning section contains resources for our three risk products: Expense Check, Income Check, and Risk Insights. Use the endpoints to create, delete, get, and list risk data and reports.

## Expense Check[](#risk/expense-check)

## Create an expense check report[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report)

`POST /risk/v1/expense-checks`

Creates an expense check report containing the expenses of an end-user.

### Works with[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/works-with)

| ACCEPTED TOKEN TYPES | REQUIRED SCOPES |
| --- | --- |
| User token | `expense-checks:create` |

> Request Example

```
{
  "externalReference": "ln-123456789"
}
```

### Request Body: CreateExpenseCheckRequest[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/request-body-createexpensecheckrequest)

The object to be sent for creating an expense check.

externalReference `string`

Optional reference given by the customer to add information, such as UID, to the generated report. (Validation: allowed lowercase and uppercase letters, numbers and dashes. Max 50 characters in length).

### Response: ExpenseCheck[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck)

accounts `array[Account]` required

Contains user's accounts data.

appId `string` required

The identifier of the app that has been created by the client in console and linked to the expense check product.

createdTime `Date` required

The creation time of the expense check report.

engineVersion `string` required

The version of the engine that generated the expense check report.

expenses `Expenses` required

List of expenses for the user.

externalReference `string`

An external reference given by the client when creating the expense check report.

id `string` required

The internal identifier of the expense check report.

identity `Identity`

User's identity information. Availability of this data depends on the chosen provider.

summary `ExpenseSummary`

Expense summary.

userId `string` required

The internal identifier of the user linked to the request.

#### Account[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/account)

accountNumber `string`

Account's unique identifier number.

holderNames `array[string]`

Names of account holders. Availability of this data depends on the chosen provider.

id `string`

Account's internal identifier.

name `string`

Account's display name.

#### Expenses[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/expenses)

childRelated `ExpenseCategory` required

Expenses related to daycare or education as well as alimony.

collections `ExpenseCategory` required

Expenses related to debt collection, both private and public.

creditCards `ExpenseCategory` required

Credit card payments.

groceries `ExpenseCategory` required

Purchases at grocery stores.

healthcare `ExpenseCategory` required

Healthcare expenses, such as pharmaceutical products, optician tests, or medical consultations (health or dental).

housing `ExpenseCategory` required

Housing expenses, including mortgage amortization, mortgage interest, housing cooperative, as well as rent payments.

insurance `ExpenseCategory` required

Insurance expenses for all types of insurance as well as union payments.

loans `ExpenseCategory` required

Loan payments, excluding mortgages.

other `ExpenseCategory` required

Expenses that do not fit into any of the other categories.

savingsAndInvestments `ExpenseCategory` required

Recurring transfers to savings accounts as well as investment platforms.

subscriptionsAndIt `ExpenseCategory` required

Subscription expenses such as streaming services, telephone bills, etc.

taxes `ExpenseCategory` required

Tax related expenses i.e property tax, wealth tax stemming from specified transactions or a payment to tax authorities etc.

transfers `ExpenseCategory` required

Recurring transfers to internal or external (but private) bank accounts.

transportation `ExpenseCategory` required

Transportation costs such as public transport, petrol and car leasing agreements.

utilities `ExpenseCategory` required

Utility expenses for electricity, water, waste etc.

#### ExpenseCategory[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/expensecategory)

activeSpending `ActiveSpending` required

User's current month-normalized spending for a given category.

irregular `IrregularExpenses` required

User's irregular expenses for a given category. Empty if there were no irregular expenses for the given category.

recurring `RecurringExpenses` required

User's recurring expenses for a given category. Empty if there were no recurring expenses for the given category.

summaries `Summaries` required

Field containing summary-statistics about a specific category.

#### ActiveSpending[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/activespending)

estimate `CurrencyDenominatedAmount` required

User's current month-normalized spending estimate for a given category.

#### CurrencyDenominatedAmount[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/currencydenominatedamount)

currencyCode `string`

The currency code which follows ISO-4217 standard.

value `ExactNumber`

The value representation of the monetary amount.

#### ExactNumber[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/exactnumber)

scale `string`

The scale of the numeric value. `unscaledValue` is used with `scale` to accurately represent floating point values. The formula is `unscaledValue * (10^-scale)`. For example, if scale is 1 and unscaledValue is 1230, the end result would be 123.0.

unscaledValue `string`

The unscaled numeric value. `unscaledValue` is used with `scale` to accurately represent floating point values. The formula is `unscaledValue * (10^-scale)`. For example, if scale is 1 and unscaledValue is 1230, the end result would be 123.0.

#### IrregularExpenses[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/irregularexpenses)

irregularExpenses `array[IrregularExpense]` required

All Irregular expenses listed.

#### IrregularExpense[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/irregularexpense)

count `integer` required

The number of occurrences of the expense.

description `string` required

The description of transactions in the expense.

mean `CurrencyDenominatedAmount` required

The mean amount of irregular expenses.

total `CurrencyDenominatedAmount` required

The total amount of irregular expenses.

#### RecurringExpenses[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/recurringexpenses)

active `array[RecurringExpenseStream]` required

Ongoing (currently active) recurring expense streams.

inactive `array[RecurringExpenseStream]` required

Recurring expense streams which do not show any recent activity. This is decided by looking at the time interval between payments and allowing for them to be up to a month late.

#### RecurringExpenseStream[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/recurringexpensestream)

firstSeenTime `Date` required

Date when the first transaction in the stream occurred.

id `string` required

The ID of the recurring expense stream.

lastSeenTime `Date` required

Date when the latest transaction in the stream occurred.

name `string` required

Name of the recurring expense stream.

periodicity `Periodicity` required

Stream's periodicity.

transactions `array[Transaction]` required

The list of transactions in the stream.

#### Periodicity[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/periodicity)

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| WEEKLY | Weekly. |
| EVERY\_TWO\_WEEKS | Every two weeks. |
| MONTHLY | Monthly. |
| EVERY\_TWO\_MONTHS | Every two months. |
| QUARTERLY | Quarterly. |
| EVERY\_SIX\_MONTHS | Every six months. |
| ANNUALLY | Annually. |

#### Transaction[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/transaction)

amount `CurrencyDenominatedAmount` required

Transaction's amount.

description `string` required

Transaction's description.

id `string` required

Transaction's internal identifier.

time `Date` required

Transaction's timestamp.

#### Summaries[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/summaries)

percentageStatistics `PercentageStats` required

Percentage breakdowns for transaction counts and transaction amount.

summariesByMonth `SummariesByMonth` required

Summaries for three, six and twelve month periods.

#### PercentageStats[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/percentagestats)

amountPercentage `number` required

Percentage of user's total spending for the given expense category.

transactionsPercentage `number` required

Percentage of user's total transactions for the given expense category.

#### SummariesByMonth[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/summariesbymonth)

lastSixMonths `AmountSummary` required

Six month expense summary.

lastThreeMonths `AmountSummary` required

Three month expense summary.

lastTwelveMonths `AmountSummary` required

Twelve month expense summary.

#### AmountSummary[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/amountsummary)

max `ExactNumber` required

The maximum expense amount for the summary period.

mean `ExactNumber` required

The mean expense amount for the summary period.

median `ExactNumber` required

The median expense amount for the summary period.

min `ExactNumber` required

The minimum expense amount for the summary period.

total `ExactNumber` required

The total expense amount for the summary period.

#### Identity[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/identity)

name `string`

The name of the end-user that is logging in to their bank.

ssn `string`

The end-user's social security number (depending on the availability of such from the underlying bank, cannot be assumed to be populated per default).

#### ExpenseSummary[](#risk/expense-check/create-an-expense-check-report/response-expensecheck/expensesummary)

totalActiveSpending `ActiveSpending` required

User's current month-normalized spending for a all expense categories.

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | A successful response. |
| 400 | The request does not pass validation or there is not enough data to perform calculations on. Check the error message or the documentation for more information. |
| 401 | Wrong scopes associated with the access token. |
| 403 | The resource does not belong to subject associated with the access token. |
| default | An unexpected error response. |

## Delete an expense check[](#risk/expense-check/delete-an-expense-check)

`DELETE /risk/v1/expense-checks/{id}`

Deletes an expense check by id.

### Works with[](#risk/expense-check/delete-an-expense-check/works-with)

| ACCEPTED TOKEN TYPES | REQUIRED SCOPES |
| --- | --- |
| Client token | `expense-checks:delete` |

### Parameters[](#risk/expense-check/delete-an-expense-check/parameters)

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| idrequired | The internal identifier of an expense check. |

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | A successful response. |
| 401 | Wrong scopes associated with the access token. |
| 403 | The resource does not belong to subject associated with the access token. |
| 404 | An expense check with the given id was not found. |
| default | An unexpected error response. |

## Get an expense check[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check)

`GET /risk/v1/expense-checks/{id}`

Gets an expense check by id.

### Works with[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/works-with)

| ACCEPTED TOKEN TYPES | REQUIRED SCOPES |
| --- | --- |
| Client token | `expense-checks:readonly` |

### Parameters[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/parameters)

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| idrequired | The internal identifier of an expense check. |

### Response: ExpenseCheck[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck)

accounts `array[Account]` required

Contains user's accounts data.

appId `string` required

The identifier of the app that has been created by the client in console and linked to the expense check product.

createdTime `Date` required

The creation time of the expense check report.

engineVersion `string` required

The version of the engine that generated the expense check report.

expenses `Expenses` required

List of expenses for the user.

externalReference `string`

An external reference given by the client when creating the expense check report.

id `string` required

The internal identifier of the expense check report.

identity `Identity`

User's identity information. Availability of this data depends on the chosen provider.

summary `ExpenseSummary`

Expense summary.

userId `string` required

The internal identifier of the user linked to the request.

#### Account[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/account)

accountNumber `string`

Account's unique identifier number.

holderNames `array[string]`

Names of account holders. Availability of this data depends on the chosen provider.

id `string`

Account's internal identifier.

name `string`

Account's display name.

#### Expenses[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/expenses)

childRelated `ExpenseCategory` required

Expenses related to daycare or education as well as alimony.

collections `ExpenseCategory` required

Expenses related to debt collection, both private and public.

creditCards `ExpenseCategory` required

Credit card payments.

groceries `ExpenseCategory` required

Purchases at grocery stores.

healthcare `ExpenseCategory` required

Healthcare expenses, such as pharmaceutical products, optician tests, or medical consultations (health or dental).

housing `ExpenseCategory` required

Housing expenses, including mortgage amortization, mortgage interest, housing cooperative, as well as rent payments.

insurance `ExpenseCategory` required

Insurance expenses for all types of insurance as well as union payments.

loans `ExpenseCategory` required

Loan payments, excluding mortgages.

other `ExpenseCategory` required

Expenses that do not fit into any of the other categories.

savingsAndInvestments `ExpenseCategory` required

Recurring transfers to savings accounts as well as investment platforms.

subscriptionsAndIt `ExpenseCategory` required

Subscription expenses such as streaming services, telephone bills, etc.

taxes `ExpenseCategory` required

Tax related expenses i.e property tax, wealth tax stemming from specified transactions or a payment to tax authorities etc.

transfers `ExpenseCategory` required

Recurring transfers to internal or external (but private) bank accounts.

transportation `ExpenseCategory` required

Transportation costs such as public transport, petrol and car leasing agreements.

utilities `ExpenseCategory` required

Utility expenses for electricity, water, waste etc.

#### ExpenseCategory[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/expensecategory)

activeSpending `ActiveSpending` required

User's current month-normalized spending for a given category.

irregular `IrregularExpenses` required

User's irregular expenses for a given category. Empty if there were no irregular expenses for the given category.

recurring `RecurringExpenses` required

User's recurring expenses for a given category. Empty if there were no recurring expenses for the given category.

summaries `Summaries` required

Field containing summary-statistics about a specific category.

#### ActiveSpending[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/activespending)

estimate `CurrencyDenominatedAmount` required

User's current month-normalized spending estimate for a given category.

#### CurrencyDenominatedAmount[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/currencydenominatedamount)

currencyCode `string`

The currency code which follows ISO-4217 standard.

value `ExactNumber`

The value representation of the monetary amount.

#### ExactNumber[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/exactnumber)

scale `string`

The scale of the numeric value. `unscaledValue` is used with `scale` to accurately represent floating point values. The formula is `unscaledValue * (10^-scale)`. For example, if scale is 1 and unscaledValue is 1230, the end result would be 123.0.

unscaledValue `string`

The unscaled numeric value. `unscaledValue` is used with `scale` to accurately represent floating point values. The formula is `unscaledValue * (10^-scale)`. For example, if scale is 1 and unscaledValue is 1230, the end result would be 123.0.

#### IrregularExpenses[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/irregularexpenses)

irregularExpenses `array[IrregularExpense]` required

All Irregular expenses listed.

#### IrregularExpense[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/irregularexpense)

count `integer` required

The number of occurrences of the expense.

description `string` required

The description of transactions in the expense.

mean `CurrencyDenominatedAmount` required

The mean amount of irregular expenses.

total `CurrencyDenominatedAmount` required

The total amount of irregular expenses.

#### RecurringExpenses[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/recurringexpenses)

active `array[RecurringExpenseStream]` required

Ongoing (currently active) recurring expense streams.

inactive `array[RecurringExpenseStream]` required

Recurring expense streams which do not show any recent activity. This is decided by looking at the time interval between payments and allowing for them to be up to a month late.

#### RecurringExpenseStream[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/recurringexpensestream)

firstSeenTime `Date` required

Date when the first transaction in the stream occurred.

id `string` required

The ID of the recurring expense stream.

lastSeenTime `Date` required

Date when the latest transaction in the stream occurred.

name `string` required

Name of the recurring expense stream.

periodicity `Periodicity` required

Stream's periodicity.

transactions `array[Transaction]` required

The list of transactions in the stream.

#### Periodicity[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/periodicity)

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| WEEKLY | Weekly. |
| EVERY\_TWO\_WEEKS | Every two weeks. |
| MONTHLY | Monthly. |
| EVERY\_TWO\_MONTHS | Every two months. |
| QUARTERLY | Quarterly. |
| EVERY\_SIX\_MONTHS | Every six months. |
| ANNUALLY | Annually. |

#### Transaction[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/transaction)

amount `CurrencyDenominatedAmount` required

Transaction's amount.

description `string` required

Transaction's description.

id `string` required

Transaction's internal identifier.

time `Date` required

Transaction's timestamp.

#### Summaries[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/summaries)

percentageStatistics `PercentageStats` required

Percentage breakdowns for transaction counts and transaction amount.

summariesByMonth `SummariesByMonth` required

Summaries for three, six and twelve month periods.

#### PercentageStats[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/percentagestats)

amountPercentage `number` required

Percentage of user's total spending for the given expense category.

transactionsPercentage `number` required

Percentage of user's total transactions for the given expense category.

#### SummariesByMonth[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/summariesbymonth)

lastSixMonths `AmountSummary` required

Six month expense summary.

lastThreeMonths `AmountSummary` required

Three month expense summary.

lastTwelveMonths `AmountSummary` required

Twelve month expense summary.

#### AmountSummary[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/amountsummary)

max `ExactNumber` required

The maximum expense amount for the summary period.

mean `ExactNumber` required

The mean expense amount for the summary period.

median `ExactNumber` required

The median expense amount for the summary period.

min `ExactNumber` required

The minimum expense amount for the summary period.

total `ExactNumber` required

The total expense amount for the summary period.

#### Identity[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/identity)

name `string`

The name of the end-user that is logging in to their bank.

ssn `string`

The end-user's social security number (depending on the availability of such from the underlying bank, cannot be assumed to be populated per default).

#### ExpenseSummary[](#risk/expense-check/get-an-expense-check/response-expensecheck/expensesummary)

totalActiveSpending `ActiveSpending` required

User's current month-normalized spending for a all expense categories.

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | A successful response. |
| 400 | The request does not pass validation. This could for example be an invalid id. Check the error message or the documentation of each field for more information. |
| 401 | Wrong scopes associated with the access token. |
| 403 | The resource does not belong to subject associated with the access token. |
| 404 | An expense check with the given id was not found. |
| default | An unexpected error response. |

## List expense checks[](#risk/expense-check/list-expense-checks)

`GET /risk/v1/expense-checks`

Lists expense checks.

### Works with[](#risk/expense-check/list-expense-checks/works-with)

| ACCEPTED TOKEN TYPES | REQUIRED SCOPES |
| --- | --- |
| Client token | `expense-checks:readonly` |

### Query Parameters[](#risk/expense-check/list-expense-checks/query-parameters)

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| pageSize | Maximum number of instances returned. |
| pageToken | Pointer to the requested page. |

> Response Example

```
{
  "expenseChecks": [
    {
      "appId": "56a33be25eb9443fbb696f7c61eabd94",
      "createdTime": "2021-04-22T09:59:56.966Z",
      "engineVersion": "1.0.0",
      "externalReference": "ext-abc-123",
      "id": "a8efc70a24a5e4aed0f8d3e5380b01fd74fc9cd1",
      "identity": {
        "name": "John Doe",
        "ssn": "19800101-1234"
      },
      "userId": "9e0b1c0d74967147744f0d076e805dfb2df7b4b3"
    }
  ],
  "nextPageToken": "MA=",
  "prevPageToken": "MA=="
}
```

### Response: ListExpenseChecksResponse[](#risk/expense-check/list-expense-checks/response-listexpensechecksresponse)

expenseChecks `array[ExpenseCheckSummary]` required

List of instances.

nextPageToken `string`

Pointer to the next page.

prevPageToken `string`

Pointer to the previous page.

#### ExpenseCheckSummary[](#risk/expense-check/list-expense-checks/response-listexpensechecksresponse/expensechecksummary)

appId `string` required

The identifier of the app that has been created by the client in console and linked to the expense check product.

createdTime `Date` required

The creation time of the expense check.

engineVersion `string` required

The version of the engine that generated the expense check.

externalReference `string`

An external reference given by the client when creating the expense check.

id `string` required

The internal identifier of the expense check.

identity `Identity`

User's identity information. Availability of this data depends on the chosen provider.

userId `string` required

The internal identifier of the user linked to the request.

#### Identity[](#risk/expense-check/list-expense-checks/response-listexpensechecksresponse/identity)

name `string`

The name of the end-user that is logging in to their bank.

ssn `string`

The end-user's social security number (depending on the availability of such from the underlying bank, cannot be assumed to be populated per default).

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | A successful response. |
| 400 | The request does not pass validation. This could for example be an invalid app id. Check the error message or the documentation of each field for more information. |
| 401 | Wrong scopes associated with the access token. |
| 403 | The resource does not belong to subject associated with the access token. |
| default | An unexpected error response. |

## Income Check[](#risk/income-check)

## Create an income check[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check)

`POST /v2/income-checks`

Creates a request and returns the income of an end-user as a JSON response.

### Works with[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/works-with)

| ACCEPTED TOKEN TYPES | REQUIRED SCOPES |
| --- | --- |
| User token | `income-checks:create` |

> Request Example

```
{
  "engineVersion": "1.0.0",
  "externalReference": "ln-123456789"
}
```

### Request Body: CreateIncomeCheckRequest[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/request-body-createincomecheckrequest)

The object to be sent for creating an income check.

engineVersion `string`

Optional version of the engine that generates the income check. If omitted, the latest engine version will be used. See [Changelog](/Tiny-doc/tink_docs_home/changelog/) for more details.

externalReference `string`

Optional reference given by the customer to add information, such as UID, to the generated report. (Validation: allowed lowercase and uppercase letters, numbers and dashes. Max 50 characters in length).

### Response: IncomeCheck[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/response-incomecheck)

accounts `array[Account]` required

Contains user accounts data.

appId `string`

The identifier of the app that has been created by the client in console and linked to the income check product.

createdTime `Date`

The creation time of the income check.

engineVersion `string`

The version of the engine that generated the income check.

externalReference `string`

An external reference given by the client when creating the income check.

id `string` required

The internal identifier of the income check.

identity `incomechecksIdentity`

User's identity information. Availability of this data depends on the chosen provider.

income `Income`

List of income streams for this user.

userId `string`

The internal identifier of the user linked to the request.

#### Account[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/account)

accountNumber `string`

Account's unique identifier number.

financialInstitutionName `string`

The name of a bank or other financial service providers.

holderNames `array[string]`

Names of account holders. Availability of this data depends on the chosen provider.

iban `string`

Account's IBAN identifier.

id `string` required

Account's internal identifier.

name `string` required

Account's display name.

users `array[User]` required

Account users and their associated roles. Availability of this data depends on the chosen provider.

#### User[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/user)

name `string` required

Account user's name.

role `string` required

Account user's role.

#### incomechecksIdentity[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/incomechecksidentity)

name `string` required

The name of the user.

ssn `string` required

User's social security number.

#### Income[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/income)

primaryIncomeStreamId `string`

The id of the primary income stream.

streams `array[IncomeStream]` required

User's income streams.

summary `IncomeSummary` required

The summary of each income stream.

#### IncomeStream[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/incomestream)

accountId `string`

The account number connected to the income stream.

currencyCode `string`

The currency code according to ISO-4217 standard.

id `string` required

Income stream's (helper) identifier used only in the response.

occurrences `OccurrenceSummary`

The occurrence summary of the stream.

subType `IncomeSubType`

The income sub-type of the income stream.

summaryByMonths `SummaryByMonths`

The summary of the income stream calculated by month.

summaryByTransactions `SummaryByTransactions`

The summary of the income stream calculated by transactions.

transactions `array[Transaction]` required

The list of transactions in the stream.

type `IncomeType` required

The type of the income stream.

#### OccurrenceSummary[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/occurrencesummary)

count `integer` required

The number of occurrences.

first `string` required

The date of the first occurrence.

last `string` required

The date of the last occurrence.

#### IncomeSubType[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/incomesubtype)

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| SUB\_TYPE\_UNDETERMINED | Income sub-type was undetermined. |
| SALARY\_SUB\_TYPE\_SALARY | Income sub-type identified as a salary, regular salary from an employer. |
| SALARY\_SUB\_TYPE\_GIG | Income sub-type identified as a gig, irregular salary from gig employment. Often smaller amounts. |
| SALARY\_SUB\_TYPE\_BONUS | Income sub-type identified as a bonus, bonus payments that are often larger and less frequent. |
| SALARY\_SUB\_TYPE\_OTHER\_SALARY | Income sub-type identified as other, for example salary payments such as expense reimbursements. |
| BENEFITS\_SUB\_TYPE\_ALIMONY | Income sub-type identified as alimony, financial support paid to previous spouse. |
| BENEFITS\_SUB\_TYPE\_CHILD\_SUPPORT | Income sub-type identified as a child support, different types of child benefits. |
| BENEFITS\_SUB\_TYPE\_UNEMPLOYMENT | Income sub-type identified as unemployment, unable to work benefits. |
| BENEFITS\_SUB\_TYPE\_OTHER\_BENEFIT | Income sub-type identified as other, any other benefit not included in the previous sub-types. |
| PENSION\_SUB\_TYPE\_PRIVATE | Income sub-type identified as a pension that is paid from the employer. |
| PENSION\_SUB\_TYPE\_STATE | Income sub-type identified as a pension that is paid from the state. |
| PENSION\_SUB\_TYPE\_OTHER\_PENSION | Income sub-type identified as other, any other pension not included in the previous sub-types. |
| CASH\_DEPOSITS\_SUB\_TYPE\_CASH | Income sub-type identified as cash deposits. |
| CASH\_DEPOSITS\_SUB\_TYPE\_CHEQUE | Income sub-type identified as a cheque deposits. |
| CASH\_DEPOSITS\_SUB\_TYPE\_OTHER\_CASH\_DEPOSITS | Income sub-type identified as a other, any other cash deposits not included in the previous sub-types. |
| OTHER\_SUB\_TYPE\_INSURANCE | Income sub-type identified as insurance. |
| OTHER\_SUB\_TYPE\_RENTAL | Income sub-type identified as a rental income. |
| OTHER\_SUB\_TYPE\_EDUCATIONAL\_GRANT | Income sub-type identified as educational grants. |
| OTHER\_SUB\_TYPE\_SECOND\_HAND\_SALES | Income sub-type identified as a second hand sale, external transfers related to 2nd hand sales. |
| OTHER\_SUB\_TYPE\_FINANCIAL | Income sub-type identified as a financial, different types of dividends, savings or investment income that meet regulatory rules. |
| OTHER\_SUB\_TYPE\_EXTERNAL\_TRANSFER | Income sub-type identified as a external transfer, regular third party transfers and standing orders that are not 1st party transfers. |
| OTHER\_SUB\_TYPE\_OTHER | Income sub-type identified as other, any other type of regular income that does not fall into the other categories. |

#### SummaryByMonths[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/summarybymonths)

lastSixMonths `AmountSummary`

The monthly amount summary of the last six months.

lastThreeMonths `AmountSummary`

The monthly amount summary of the last three months.

lastTwelveMonths `AmountSummary`

The monthly amount summary of the last twelve months.

#### AmountSummary[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/amountsummary)

max `ExactNumber` required

The maximum of the amount.

mean `ExactNumber` required

The average of the amount.

median `ExactNumber` required

The median of the amount.

min `ExactNumber` required

The minimum of the amount.

total `ExactNumber` required

The total of the amount.

#### ExactNumber[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/exactnumber)

scale `string`

The scale of the numeric value. `unscaledValue` is used with `scale` to accurately represent floating point values. The formula is `unscaledValue * (10^-scale)`. For example, if scale is 1 and unscaledValue is 1230, the end result would be 123.0.

unscaledValue `string`

The unscaled numeric value. `unscaledValue` is used with `scale` to accurately represent floating point values. The formula is `unscaledValue * (10^-scale)`. For example, if scale is 1 and unscaledValue is 1230, the end result would be 123.0.

#### SummaryByTransactions[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/summarybytransactions)

lastSixMonths `AmountSummary`

The monthly amount summary of the last six months.

lastThreeMonths `AmountSummary`

The monthly amount summary of the last three months.

lastTwelveMonths `AmountSummary`

The monthly amount summary of the last twelve months.

#### Transaction[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/transaction)

accountId `string`

Account's internal identifier.

amount `CurrencyDenominatedAmount` required

Transaction's amount.

description `string` required

Transaction's description.

id `string` required

Transaction's internal identifier.

time `Date` required

Transaction's timestamp.

#### CurrencyDenominatedAmount[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/currencydenominatedamount)

currencyCode `string`

The currency code which follows ISO-4217 standard.

value `ExactNumber`

The value representation of the monetary amount.

#### IncomeType[](#risk/income-check/create-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/incometype)

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| OTHER | Income that does not fall into any specific type. |
| SALARY | Income identified as a salary. |
| PENSION | Income identified as a pension. |
| BENEFITS | Income identified as a benefit. |
| CASH\_DEPOSITS | Income identified as a cash deposit. |

## Delete an income check[](#risk/income-check/delete-an-income-check)

`DELETE /v2/income-checks/{id}`

Deletes an income check by id.

### Works with[](#risk/income-check/delete-an-income-check/works-with)

| ACCEPTED TOKEN TYPES | REQUIRED SCOPES |
| --- | --- |
| Client token | `income-checks:delete` |

### Parameters[](#risk/income-check/delete-an-income-check/parameters)

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| idrequired | The internal identifier of an income check. |

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | A successful response. |
| 401 | Wrong scopes associated with the access token. |
| 403 | The resource does not belong to subject associated with the access token. |
| 404 | An income check with the given id was not found. |
| default | An unexpected error response. |

## Generate an income check as PDF[](#risk/income-check/generate-an-income-check-as-pdf)

`GET /v2/income-checks/{id}:generate-pdf`

### Works with[](#risk/income-check/generate-an-income-check-as-pdf/works-with)

| ACCEPTED TOKEN TYPES | REQUIRED SCOPES |
| --- | --- |
| Client token | `income-checks:readonly` |

### Parameters[](#risk/income-check/generate-an-income-check-as-pdf/parameters)

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| idrequired | The internal identifier of an income check. |

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | A successful response.(streaming responses) |
| 400 | The request does not pass validation. This could for example be an invalid app id. Check the error message or the documentation of each field for more information. |
| 401 | Wrong scopes associated with the access token. |
| 403 | The resource does not belong to subject associated with the access token. |
| 404 | An income check with the given id was not found. |
| default | An unexpected error response. |

### Response: IncomeCheck[](#risk/income-check/get-an-income-check/response-incomecheck)

accounts `array[Account]` required

Contains user accounts data.

appId `string`

The identifier of the app that has been created by the client in console and linked to the income check product.

createdTime `Date`

The creation time of the income check.

engineVersion `string`

The version of the engine that generated the income check.

externalReference `string`

An external reference given by the client when creating the income check.

id `string` required

The internal identifier of the income check.

identity `incomechecksIdentity`

User's identity information. Availability of this data depends on the chosen provider.

income `Income`

List of income streams for this user.

userId `string`

The internal identifier of the user linked to the request.

#### Account[](#risk/income-check/get-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/account)

accountNumber `string`

Account's unique identifier number.

financialInstitutionName `string`

The name of a bank or other financial service providers.

holderNames `array[string]`

Names of account holders. Availability of this data depends on the chosen provider.

iban `string`

Account's IBAN identifier.

id `string` required

Account's internal identifier.

name `string` required

Account's display name.

users `array[User]` required

Account users and their associated roles. Availability of this data depends on the chosen provider.

#### User[](#risk/income-check/get-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/user)

name `string` required

Account user's name.

role `string` required

Account user's role.

#### incomechecksIdentity[](#risk/income-check/get-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/incomechecksidentity)

name `string` required

The name of the user.

ssn `string` required

User's social security number.

#### Income[](#risk/income-check/get-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/income)

primaryIncomeStreamId `string`

The id of the primary income stream.

streams `array[IncomeStream]` required

User's income streams.

summary `IncomeSummary` required

The summary of each income stream.

#### IncomeStream[](#risk/income-check/get-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/incomestream)

accountId `string`

The account number connected to the income stream.

currencyCode `string`

The currency code according to ISO-4217 standard.

id `string` required

Income stream's (helper) identifier used only in the response.

occurrences `OccurrenceSummary`

The occurrence summary of the stream.

subType `IncomeSubType`

The income sub-type of the income stream.

summaryByMonths `SummaryByMonths`

The summary of the income stream calculated by month.

summaryByTransactions `SummaryByTransactions`

The summary of the income stream calculated by transactions.

transactions `array[Transaction]` required

The list of transactions in the stream.

type `IncomeType` required

The type of the income stream.

#### OccurrenceSummary[](#risk/income-check/get-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/occurrencesummary)

count `integer` required

The number of occurrences.

first `string` required

The date of the first occurrence.

last `string` required

The date of the last occurrence.

#### IncomeSubType[](#risk/income-check/get-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/incomesubtype)

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| SUB\_TYPE\_UNDETERMINED | Income sub-type was undetermined. |
| SALARY\_SUB\_TYPE\_SALARY | Income sub-type identified as a salary, regular salary from an employer. |
| SALARY\_SUB\_TYPE\_GIG | Income sub-type identified as a gig, irregular salary from gig employment. Often smaller amounts. |
| SALARY\_SUB\_TYPE\_BONUS | Income sub-type identified as a bonus, bonus payments that are often larger and less frequent. |
| SALARY\_SUB\_TYPE\_OTHER\_SALARY | Income sub-type identified as other, for example salary payments such as expense reimbursements. |
| BENEFITS\_SUB\_TYPE\_ALIMONY | Income sub-type identified as alimony, financial support paid to previous spouse. |
| BENEFITS\_SUB\_TYPE\_CHILD\_SUPPORT | Income sub-type identified as a child support, different types of child benefits. |
| BENEFITS\_SUB\_TYPE\_UNEMPLOYMENT | Income sub-type identified as unemployment, unable to work benefits. |
| BENEFITS\_SUB\_TYPE\_OTHER\_BENEFIT | Income sub-type identified as other, any other benefit not included in the previous sub-types. |
| PENSION\_SUB\_TYPE\_PRIVATE | Income sub-type identified as a pension that is paid from the employer. |
| PENSION\_SUB\_TYPE\_STATE | Income sub-type identified as a pension that is paid from the state. |
| PENSION\_SUB\_TYPE\_OTHER\_PENSION | Income sub-type identified as other, any other pension not included in the previous sub-types. |
| CASH\_DEPOSITS\_SUB\_TYPE\_CASH | Income sub-type identified as cash deposits. |
| CASH\_DEPOSITS\_SUB\_TYPE\_CHEQUE | Income sub-type identified as a cheque deposits. |
| CASH\_DEPOSITS\_SUB\_TYPE\_OTHER\_CASH\_DEPOSITS | Income sub-type identified as a other, any other cash deposits not included in the previous sub-types. |
| OTHER\_SUB\_TYPE\_INSURANCE | Income sub-type identified as insurance. |
| OTHER\_SUB\_TYPE\_RENTAL | Income sub-type identified as a rental income. |
| OTHER\_SUB\_TYPE\_EDUCATIONAL\_GRANT | Income sub-type identified as educational grants. |
| OTHER\_SUB\_TYPE\_SECOND\_HAND\_SALES | Income sub-type identified as a second hand sale, external transfers related to 2nd hand sales. |
| OTHER\_SUB\_TYPE\_FINANCIAL | Income sub-type identified as a financial, different types of dividends, savings or investment income that meet regulatory rules. |
| OTHER\_SUB\_TYPE\_EXTERNAL\_TRANSFER | Income sub-type identified as a external transfer, regular third party transfers and standing orders that are not 1st party transfers. |
| OTHER\_SUB\_TYPE\_OTHER | Income sub-type identified as other, any other type of regular income that does not fall into the other categories. |

#### SummaryByMonths[](#risk/income-check/get-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/summarybymonths)

lastSixMonths `AmountSummary`

The monthly amount summary of the last six months.

lastThreeMonths `AmountSummary`

The monthly amount summary of the last three months.

lastTwelveMonths `AmountSummary`

The monthly amount summary of the last twelve months.

#### AmountSummary[](#risk/income-check/get-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/amountsummary)

max `ExactNumber` required

The maximum of the amount.

mean `ExactNumber` required

The average of the amount.

median `ExactNumber` required

The median of the amount.

min `ExactNumber` required

The minimum of the amount.

total `ExactNumber` required

The total of the amount.

#### ExactNumber[](#risk/income-check/get-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/exactnumber)

scale `string`

The scale of the numeric value. `unscaledValue` is used with `scale` to accurately represent floating point values. The formula is `unscaledValue * (10^-scale)`. For example, if scale is 1 and unscaledValue is 1230, the end result would be 123.0.

unscaledValue `string`

The unscaled numeric value. `unscaledValue` is used with `scale` to accurately represent floating point values. The formula is `unscaledValue * (10^-scale)`. For example, if scale is 1 and unscaledValue is 1230, the end result would be 123.0.

#### SummaryByTransactions[](#risk/income-check/get-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/summarybytransactions)

lastSixMonths `AmountSummary`

The monthly amount summary of the last six months.

lastThreeMonths `AmountSummary`

The monthly amount summary of the last three months.

lastTwelveMonths `AmountSummary`

The monthly amount summary of the last twelve months.

#### Transaction[](#risk/income-check/get-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/transaction)

accountId `string`

Account's internal identifier.

amount `CurrencyDenominatedAmount` required

Transaction's amount.

description `string` required

Transaction's description.

id `string` required

Transaction's internal identifier.

time `Date` required

Transaction's timestamp.

#### CurrencyDenominatedAmount[](#risk/income-check/get-an-income-check/response-incomecheck/currencydenominatedamount)

currencyCode `string`

The currency code which follows ISO-4217 standard.

value `ExactNumber`

The value representation of the monetary amount.

| Value | Description |

| OTHER | Income that does not fall into any specific type. |
| SALARY | Income identified as a salary. |
| PENSION | Income identified as a pension. |
| BENEFITS | Income identified as a benefit. |
| CASH\_DEPOSITS | Income identified as a cash deposit. |

## List income checks[](#risk/income-check/list-income-checks)

`GET /v2/income-checks`

Lists income checks.

### Works with[](#risk/income-check/list-income-checks/works-with)

| ACCEPTED TOKEN TYPES | REQUIRED SCOPES |
| --- | --- |
| Client token | `income-checks:readonly` |

### Query Parameters[](#risk/income-check/list-income-checks/query-parameters)

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| pageSize | Maximum number of instances returned. |
| pageToken | Pointer to the requested page. |
| appIdEq | App identifier to filter on. |
| identity.ssnEq | Social security number to filter on. |
| externalReferenceEq | External reference to filter on. |
| dateLte | Less than or equal to date string to filter on. ISO8601 UTC in Zulu: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. |
| dateGte | Greater than or equal to date string to filter on. ISO8601 UTC in Zulu: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. |

> Response Example

```
{
  "incomeChecks": [
    {
      "appId": "56a33be25eb9443fbb696f7c61eabd94",
      "createdTime": "2021-04-22T09:59:56.966Z",
      "engineVersion": "1.0.0",
      "externalReference": "ext-abc-123",
      "id": "a8efc70a24a5e4aed0f8d3e5380b01fd74fc9cd1",
      "identity": {
        "name": "John Doe",
        "ssn": "197601011234"
      },
      "userId": "9e0b1c0d74967147744f0d076e805dfb2df7b4b3"
    }
  ],
  "nextPageToken": "MA=",
  "prevPageToken": "MA=="
}
```

### Response: ListIncomeChecksResponse[](#risk/income-check/list-income-checks/response-listincomechecksresponse)

incomeChecks `array[IncomeCheckSummary]`

List of instances.

nextPageToken `string`

Pointer to the next page.

prevPageToken `string`

Pointer to the previous page.

#### IncomeCheckSummary[](#risk/income-check/list-income-checks/response-listincomechecksresponse/incomechecksummary)

appId `string`

The identifier of the app that has been created by the client in console and linked to the income check product.

createdTime `Date`

The creation time of the income check.

engineVersion `string`

The version of the engine that generated the income check.

externalReference `string`

An external reference given by the client when creating the income check.

id `string` required

The internal identifier of the income check.

identity `incomechecksIdentity`

User's identity information. Availability of this data depends on the chosen provider.

userId `string`

The internal identifier of the user linked to the request.

#### incomechecksIdentity[](#risk/income-check/list-income-checks/response-listincomechecksresponse/incomechecksidentity)

name `string` required

The name of the user.

ssn `string` required

User's social security number.

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | A successful response. |
| 400 | The request does not pass validation. This could for example be an invalid app id. Check the error message or the documentation of each field for more information. |
| 401 | Wrong scopes associated with the access token. |
| 403 | The resource does not belong to subject associated with the access token. |
| default | An unexpected error response. |

## Risk Insights[](#risk/risk-insights)

## Create Risk Insights[](#risk/risk-insights/create-risk-insights)

`POST /risk/v1/risk-insights`

Creates a request and returns the risk insights report id of an end-user as a JSON response.

### Works with[](#risk/risk-insights/create-risk-insights/works-with)

| ACCEPTED TOKEN TYPES | REQUIRED SCOPES |
| --- | --- |
| User token | `risk-insights:create` |

> Request Example

```
{
  "externalReference": "ext-abc-123"
}
```

### Request Body: CreateRiskInsightRequest[](#risk/risk-insights/create-risk-insights/request-body-createriskinsightrequest)

The object to be sent for creating a risk insights report.

externalReference `string`

Optional reference given by the customer to add information, such as UID, to the generated report. (Validation: allowed lowercase and uppercase letters, numbers and dashes. Max 50 characters in length).

> Response Example

```
{
  "id": "61261abc769e42eebaae018bf34f1664"
}
```

### Response: CreateRiskInsightResponse[](#risk/risk-insights/create-risk-insights/response-createriskinsightresponse)

The object to sent back after creating a risk insights report.

id `string` required

The identifier of the risk insights report.

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | A successful response. |
| 401 | Authorization token is missing or invalid. |
| default | An unexpected error response. |

### Parameters[](#risk/risk-insights/delete-a-risk-insights/parameters)

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| idrequired | The internal identifier of a risk insights. |

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | A successful response. |
| 401 | Wrong scopes associated with the access token. |
| 403 | The resource does not belong to subject associated with the access token. |
| 404 | A risk insights with the given id was not found. |
| default | An unexpected error response. |

### Response: RiskInsights[](#risk/risk-insights/get-a-risk-insights/response-riskinsights)

accountActivity `AccountActivity` required

These features capture the activity of the end-user’s accounts and frequency of transactions. It includes the absolute number of in- and outgoing transactions paired with days since the first and last transaction.

accountOverview `AccountOverview` required

Features detailing the number of unique holders, currencies and accounts types discovered across an end-user’s accounts. Note that non-market currencies are filtered out during analysis, leaving the number of unique currencies to always be one.

accounts `array[Account]`

Contains user accounts data.

atmWithdrawals `AtmWithdrawals` required

These features capture ATM withdrawal behaviour of the end-user, meaning the sum of ATM withdrawals across different periods as well as ATM withdrawals in relation to total outflow.

balances `BalanceStats` required

These features provide an overview of the end-user total end-of-day balance across all accounts. We also are presenting features capturing max, min, mean and standard deviation balances across different periods.

cashFlow `CashFlowStats` required

These features capture the incoming and outgoing flows on the end-user’s accounts, respectively, across different periods. Also presented as a ratio between in- and outgoing flows where a value above 1 indicates a higher inflow and a value between 0 and 1 indicates a higher outflow.

collections `Collections` required

These features aim to measure the financial reliability of the end-user by looking at payments to collection agencies based on the transaction activity. The transactions, if any, are presented as “number of transactions” and “sum of given transactions” across different periods.

createdTime `Date` required

The creation time of the risk insights report triggered by the specific TinkLink session and the following creation of the report.

currencyCode `string` required

The currency code which follows ISO-4217 standard.

dataAvailability `array[DataAvailability]` required

A list of DataAvailability periods that correspond to the transaction history of the end user. The presence of a period in DataAvailability suggests complete data, implying a 0 value indicates no transactions and the 0 can be computed. Absence from this list suggests the 0 is due to insufficient data and a 0 would represent a calculation of “n.a.“.

externalReference `string`

An external reference given by the client when creating the risk insights report.

gamblingVsIncome `GamblingVsIncome` required

Tink’s purpose-built categorisation allows us to detect transactions going to gambling institutions. These transactions, via the given features, capture the proportion of gambling expenditure out of total incoming transactions (and not income in terms of salary but rather total inflow) and present such as a ratio as well as the absolute number of gambling related transactions across different periods.

highBalances `object` required

Features detailing how many days during a given period the end-user has had a balance (see balances for more information) above a certain threshold (different per market) in terms of the total end-of-day balance summed across all accounts.

id `string` required

The reference identifier of the Risk Insights report.

identity `Identity` required

The end-user's identity information. The availability of this data differs between markets and depends on the chosen provider/bank. Tink is interested in providing such but it cannot be relied upon being available.

loans `Loans` required

Features related to previously taken loans that we can identify via an inflow (a disbursement) to the accounts and repayments (an installment or bullet repayment) of loans that also are found on the accounts. I.e. loans/repayments not found on the transaction statement will not be included/covered. We present these features across different periods looking at the number of loans and repayments as a sum and the number of transactions found (for loans and loan repayments respectively). We also present a ratio of repayments over loans in terms of amount across the same periods.

lowBalances `object` required

The number of days the end-user has transactions that results in a balance (see balances for more information) lower than a set amount (market dependent) in terms of the total end-of-day balance summed across all accounts.

overdrafts `Overdrafts` required

These features capture any existing and previous overdraft usage of the end-user and across different periods. Overdrafts are designed to capture where and when balance was below 0 and examines individual accounts (and checks the balance after each transaction, i.e. not the end-of-day balance).

transactionStats `TransactionStats` required

These features provide an overview of the transactions made by the end-user. We dissect the number of transactions occurring as well as the sums (as well as splitting this in terms of in- and outflow). We also present the same features for unique transactions (defined as unique transaction descriptions). In this feature group we also present max and mean summaries across the transaction behaviour (in- and outgoing flow).

userId `string`

The internal identifier of the user linked to the request.
